programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: A boy genius in the 1960s finds his way into a spectacular futuristic metropolis while attempting to promote his idea for a jetpack. Decades later, he has grown into a disillusioned adult, while a girl who has the talent and enthusiasm he has lost also finds her way into this strange new world, and together they attempt to uncover its secrets. Fantasy adventure inspired by the theme park, starring George Clooney, Britt Robertson and Hugh Laurie.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Beach
programme.desc: A backpacker arrives in Bangkok, where a wild-eyed veteran traveller tells him the location of a remote paradise island. When he finally makes it to the golden beaches, he discovers there is already a community in residence. All is not as it seems, however, and the blissful idyll soon turns sour. Danny Boyle's drama, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert Carlyle, Virginie Ledoyen and Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: The Parent Trap
programme.desc: Identical twin sisters who are unaware of each other's existence meet by accident. They decide to join forces in a bid to reunite their estranged parents, and switch places to get the warring couple to kiss and make up. Remake of the 1961 Disney comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson, Elaine Hendrix and Lindsay Lohan in a dual role.

Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.desc: S1 E22 — Charges and SpecsPeralta suspects a civic leader of money laundering, but his investigation is shut down by the police commissioner. Determined to crack the case, he enlists Santiago and Captain Holt to help uncover more evidence, but risks suspension as a result.

programme.title: The Great Australian Bake Off
programme.desc: S7 E4 — Biscuit WeekIt's Biscuit Week, and the bakers must risk it for the biscuit to make Signature linzers, followed by mocha mochi cookies in the Technical, and spectacular moving biscuit vehicles for the Showstopper.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube
programme.desc: ShortsA short, cheeky clip featuring the effects of dental anaesthetics.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: S13 E27 — Ukraine: Andy and AnnaBesotted Brit Andy is really hoping to speak his bride's and mother-in-law's language by planning an authentic Ukrainian wedding in Ukraine. But while Andy's getting to know the locals, fussy bride-to-be Anna and her hard-to-please mum are banking on a very British bash. Will Andy's big wedding abroad be a hit with Anna, or will it all get lost in translation?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: The Movie
programme.desc: When their biggest rival, Humdinger, starts wreaking havoc as the mayor of Adventure City, Ryder and everyone's favourite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge.

Over two days the bakers will face three increasingly complicated challenges whilst trying to avoid a soggy bottom. Judged by acclaimed master baker Paul Hollywood and legendary cookery writer and baker Mary Berry.

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking

Nigel encourages us to experiment in the kitchen and have the confidence to make dishes up as we go along. He also visits local allotment holders and creates a tasty feast from the fruits of their labour.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers

He also visits local allotment holders, and is challenged to cook something on the plot using the freshest of ingredients.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: False Identities Special
programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. When Arthur Fitzharris's adoptive parents died he decided to find out about his birth family, and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. Bernard McGrath discovered his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him.

The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: False Identities Special
programme.desc: S13 E7Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two men, both of them born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up. When Arthur Fitzharris's adoptive parents died he decided to find out about his birth family, and was dismayed to discover that his birth certificate falsely recorded early foster parents as though they were his biological parents. Bernard McGrath discovered his adoptive parents were falsely named as his biological parents on his birth certificate and no other records seemed available to him.

programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. programme.desc: S7 E1Series featuring eyewitness filming, and those behind the stories share their memories of these once-in-a-lifetime experiences. Footage includes a plane stalling in mid-air while skydivers are clinging to the outside, and the dramatic moment a British skier fights for her life in an avalanche. Roger Allam narrates.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E131 — 02/07/2026A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E5 — The Outback & WhitsundaysThe duo head to the outback, where they meet a group of farmers and help them muster their cattle. The pair then make a pit stop at a local bar and take part in a pub quiz. The next day it's competition time as father and son go head-to-head in a race on lawnmowers. Their trip takes them towards the coast and the beautiful Whitsundays, where a trip on a super yacht awaits them. However, they won't be doing any relaxing, because they're working on board.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E7 — San AntonioThe chef begins the Texan leg of his journey in San Antonio, a city which was once part of Mexico. Here, James samples traditional tamales and barbecoa at the hands of the city's most famous chef, Johnny Hernandez. The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: S2 E4Graham Norton hosts the revival of the game show in which contestants compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes.

programme.desc: S2026 — 03/07/2026Early morning chat show presented by Lorraine Kelly, with celebrity interviews, entertainment news, cooking tips, fashion features and musical guests.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S16 E25 — Oldham 1David Dickinson and the team of antiques experts visit Oldham, Greater Manchester, where Simon Schneider falls for a stunning clock, Michael Hogben splashes out big for some gold, and the Duke himself gets stumped by an artist's print.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E11 — BeccaStephen Mulhern hosts the game show as contestant Becca tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E53Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S17 E43Bradley Walsh presents as Calum from Glasgow, Ann from Rochdale, Ali from London and Rio from Guildford pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.desc: S11 E132 — 03/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.desc: E10607 — 05/07/2026Cain warns Graham and the rest of Tates to stay away from Kyle, while Kev tells Charles he fears that Lewis wants nothing to do with him.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11892 — 05/07/2026The Driscolls pray for justice as Megan's verdict is delivered. Abi identifies her evasive landlord, Sam makes peace with Nick, and Hope and Ruby plan a surprise for Tyrone.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire Celebrity SpecialA celebrity version of the big-prize quiz in which stars answer questions to win cash for their chosen charities. With lifelines including Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend and 50-50 available to them if they get stuck.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E6The actor and his son hit the road together on a series of adventures.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: First of a three-part documentary series about people who have been conned out of money and left broken-hearted by someone they met on holiday.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Three British women and an American describe how they met their husbands while they were abroad on holiday. One discovered that her husband was planning to leave her three years into their marriage after she had paid for his visa, while another reports that her ex-husband has asked her to look after his daughter from another marriage.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Tracy, 54, travels to Turkey on a mission to get her money back from ex-lover Bulent, who has not paid back a business loan, and 51-year-old Anne Marie has over £14,000 of debt after being bamboozled by `Billy'.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: When Frank meets Angelina, they soon get married. When a mysterious illness tears them apart, the police piece together a shocking tale of greed and lies.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: When youth pastor Couty marries preacher's daughter Christa, it seems like a match made in heaven, but when Couty meets an evil end, police lift a veil of lies.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: When Shannon and David meet, their instant attraction leads to a quick wedding. But after a tragic accident, the police must dig deep to expose a web of deceit.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Cynthia and Randy elope after dating two months. But when one of the newlyweds is soon found dead, the police has to dig deep to reveal a shocking truth.

programme.title: Great Crimes and Trials
programme.sub-title: Death of a Mail Order Bride
programme.desc: A mother disappears after she drops her children off with her ex-husband. He evades police and is found with thousands of dollars and his passport.

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case, what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

programme.title: Fred & Rose West: Love & Murder
programme.desc: Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.

programme.title: Private Violence
programme.desc: Filmmaker Cynthia Hill examines the case of Deanna Walters, a survivor of spousal abuse who embarks on a crusade for justice.

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders

programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E6Runes are the letters of an ancient Germanic writing system that harkens back to a mythological age filled with heroes, magic, and mystery.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E7From 1969 to 1973, US forces bomb Cambodia and the country falls into a brutal form of communism. Did the US' involvement pave the way for Pol Pot's regime?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E8After the Cuban revolution, Fidel Castro looked to exert his influence in Venezuela. Is Cuba still in charge of Venezuela's future?

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: Mission Unexplained
programme.desc: E1During an exercise, a Staff Sergeant encounters a shadowy figure with long dark hair. She attacks him, then disappears. In one of Saddam Hussein’s former torture houses, US Marine James Gelston hears horrifying screams. Who or what did he hear?

programme.title: Mission Unexplained
programme.desc: E2In Afghanistan, Lance Corporal Jose Herrera encounters death scents, orbs of light, and unease beyond the normal stress of war. In CA, Auburn White's colleague's eyes turn black, she levitates after falling asleep, and they all seek answers.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Examining moments of engineering ingenuity which made the difference between triumph and disaster on the battlefield - beginning with World War I.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2Examining the machines used by iconic military unit 'The Desert Rats' in the North African desert campaign of World War II.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E10How will the new Cold War, involving the US, Russia, the UK and China, play out? Will trade and cyber warfare be the worst of it or is military war inevitable?

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.desc: E4Al faces up to the richest nation on Earth to discover how the former British colony of America somehow slipped through its fingers.

programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3A chronological telling of the dramatic D-Day story, focusing on vessels that made the landings possible. From the X-Craft lying on the seabed days before the invasion to battleships like USS Texas and HMS Belfast that bombarded the Normandy beaches.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4We pinpoint the moment the USA became a global superpower when we recreate how the USS Olympia won the Battle of Manila Bay, and we show how the revolutionary British HMS Dreadnought brought ship design into the 20th century.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.
